title: Cache population graph surface; only re-render on new data
details: PopulationGraph in ui.py redraws the entire canvas every frame even when data hasn't changed. Cache the rendered surface and only rebuild when new samples arrive.
notes: Caching PopulationGraph.draw(): added _cached_surf/_cache_key/_cache_version. Cache key = (version, width, height). Version increments on update()/new cls (_ensure_cls)/toggle_cls/toggle_diet/toggle_total. draw() renders to local graph_surf (width+30 for Y labels) with offset coords, caches and blits. 6 cache behavior tests + 8s sim smoke test all passed.
